# RuleType

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public enum RuleType
```

What a rule does to a rolled selection.

## Values

- <span id="f-exclude"></span>`Exclude = 0` - NONE of the targets may appear alongside the trigger. Any one of them present is a violation.
- <span id="f-require"></span>`Require = 1` - ALL of the targets must appear alongside the trigger. Any one of them missing is a violation — this is a conjunction, not a choice.
